New; round 2's grader is never imported. Fold 1: template also needs the change its body reports in the end state (spec field template_changes); an answer before the marker on its line counts; the phrase set narrowed after the label read (disclosed) and the negation scope cut at a comma and at 'but'. Post-label changes, disclosed; both reading outputs byte-identical. Fold 3 (glitch-f3's rulings on review round 3): an object hidden by punctuation or a dangling and/then read on to its sentence's end, and an elliptical request flagged for the human sample (W3A3-1, part 1); unless, though, although, whereas and which end a negator's clause (W3A3-2); a no-offer request whose sentence goes on past its object flagged, with a closed list of harmless tails (W3A3-3); an on_path pattern that matches a nonsense canary refused (W3A3-6); R1b, a closed list of read-only verbs (W3A3-7); markup stripped and R1 led by the lead adverbs (W3A3-8). Post-label changes, disclosed; both reading outputs byte-identical.
